0.title: Sprint 0: Setup & Architecture
0.goal: Put the technical foundation in place before any feature work starts. This sprint does not deliver a user-facing story; the increment is a working skeleton the team can build on.

1.title: Sprint 1: Account, Session & Admin Foundation
1.goal: A user can create an account and securely access the application; the platform can be administered separately from user accounts.

2.title: Sprint 2: Income Tracking & Category Setup
2.goal: A user can record, view, edit and total their income, and can create categories to organise spending.

3.title: Sprint 3: Expense Tracking & Category Management
3.goal: A user can record, review, edit, filter and search their expenses, with no budget required first.

4.title: Sprint 4: Budget Setup
4.goal: A user can optionally define a financial period, create an overall budget and allocate it to categories.

5.title: Sprint 5: Budget Review & Controls
5.goal: A user can review a budget, have allocations validated, edit it within the allowed window, and see it locked afterwards.

6.title: Sprint 6: Automatic Capture
6.goal: A user can capture a receipt photo or detect a mobile money transaction without typing the expense by hand.

7.title: Sprint 7: Review & Duplicate Detection
7.goal: A user can review and confirm automatically captured transactions, and duplicates are detected.

8.title: Sprint 8: Spending Totals & Budget Comparison
8.goal: A user can see total spending, spending per category, and how actual spending compares to the budget.

9.title: Sprint 9: Savings & Debt
9.goal: A user can see whether they are saving or falling into debt, with debt carried forward across periods.

10.title: Sprint 10: Dashboard & Charts
10.goal: A user can see their finances at a glance, over any time range, with charts by category and over time.

11.title: Sprint 11: Comparison, Reports & Notifications
11.goal: A user can compare periods, generate a report, and be proactively notified about what matters.

12.title: Sprint 12: AI Foundations & Insights
12.goal: A user can get savings suggestions and ask questions about their own finances in natural language.

13.title: Sprint 13: AI Comparison, Prediction & Actions
13.goal: A user can compare periods with AI, see budget risk predictions and manage expenses through chat, with confirmation before any change.

14.title: Sprint 14: Security & Performance Review
14.goal: Security and performance of the existing product are reviewed and fixed. No new features.

15.title: Sprint 15: Regression, Recovery & Release
15.goal: A stable, tested, documented and demonstrable product is released. No new features.

## User Story

As a user, I want to add, edit or delete an expense through the AI assistant, with confirmation before any change, so that I can manage my records conversationally.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Given the user asks the assistant to add, edit or delete an expense, when the assistant proposes the change, then nothing is modified until the user explicitly confirms it.
2. Given the user confirms, then the underlying expense record is updated and all dependent calculations (totals, budget balance, savings/debt) reflect the change.
3. Given the user declines or ignores the proposal, then no change is applied.
